alternate_mechanisms.name: opened_capacity_becomes_directed_desire
alternate_mechanisms.summary: Inner expansion creates room; ease and completion make that room usable; upright exertion occupies it; and desire gives the renewed capacity a single Lord-directed orientation.

alternate_mechanisms.name: strain_sound_becomes_public_testimony
alternate_mechanisms.summary: The back first makes involuntary strain audible. After relief and elevation, sound is transformed into raised voice, transmitted report, honorable mention, and testimony.

alternate_mechanisms.name: burden_relief_as_refuge_and_support
alternate_mechanisms.summary: Removal of weight is relational rehabilitation: the burdened person moves from a creaking load-bearing state into refuge, shared support, protective backing, and Lord-directed trust.

alternate_mechanisms.name: vertical_change_repairs_dignity
alternate_mechanisms.summary: The passage's lowering and raising can be read as identity repair: crushing weight and lowered standing fall away, while honor, public mention, and remembered reputation are elevated. The burden is not thereby equated with guilt.

alternate_mechanisms.name: economic_ease_as_shareable_surplus
alternate_mechanisms.summary: Hardship's scarcity pole and ease's ample-means pole open a distributive possibility: resources can become an allotted and desirable benefit given from surplus. Wealth and almsgiving remain analogues, not explicit promises or commands.

alternate_mechanisms.name: freed_capacity_is_entrusted_not_ownerless
alternate_mechanisms.summary: A burden is removed, but the resulting freedom is held within trust and purpose. Completion reallocates attention to fresh exertion, and desire directs the entrusted capacity toward the Lord.

alternate_mechanisms.name: desire_disciplined_against_appetite
alternate_mechanisms.summary: Expansion increases motivational capacity but does not determine its object. Leaving lesser priorities behind and deliberately turning attention distinguish Lord-directed aspiration from voracity or fixation on the gift itself.

alternate_mechanisms.name: ease_as_opening_for_work_not_inactivity
alternate_mechanisms.summary: Ease accompanies obstruction as a tractable opening. Completion makes attention available, but that availability immediately becomes upright effort and directed aspiration rather than permanent vacancy.
